property_summary: For any inputs the reference contract always forwards the original `from` address as the first argument to the external ERC20-style transferFrom selector (so calls target transferFrom and thus succeed/fail according to that function); the mutant instead encodes the selector for transfer(address,address,uint256) which invokes a different external entrypoint and therefore can change observable outcome (e.g., succeed vs revert) for some callee implementations.
change_summary: Replace the call target selector to invoke transfer(address,address,uint256) (no From) so the external contract's function signature differs, changing which external function is executed and thus observable behavior.
